sections.summary: The prospect expressed concerns that the pricing is too high compared to their previous annual spend of twelve and is currently unable to justify the cost. Approval from the finance owner, Dave, is required for the purchase. The prospect is open to pursuing a business case to seek budget approval from finance.
sections.followUpEmail:
Thank you for the conversation. We discussed that the current pricing is high compared to the previous annual spend of twelve on the sales stack, and that the current pricing is difficult to justify at this time. We also noted that purchase approval is required from the finance owner.

As agreed, I will work on pursuing a business case to help secure budget approval from finance.
